entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie, agent ID 402. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie... I hope you can help me. I need to return my VeloBand. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear you're disappointed. I can definitely look into that for you. To start, could you please provide your order number?
Yes, it's VF886-012. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I was so excited, but... it's just not for me.

Thank you for that, one moment... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse, delivered on January 2nd. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, it's not broken. It's just... I really needed this money back for some unexpected bills. I feel terrible about it, but I need to return it.

I understand that circumstances can change. Looking at the delivery date of January 2nd, we are on day 19 of ownership. The VeloBand Pulse has a strict 10-day return window due to hygiene standards and the way the hardware activates to a user's account. I'm afraid we're past that cutoff.

Oh, no... please. That can't be right. I tried to return it before. It must have been on day 9. I went online, but there was a huge **website error**. The whole returns portal was just a blank page. The whole **system down**, I guess.
You're saying you attempted to make the return within the 10-day window but were unable to?

Yes, exactly! I spent almost an hour trying to get it to work because I **couldn't print** the return label. It was so frustrating. I even took a **screenshot** of the error page because I was so worried this would happen. I just feel so helpless.
Thank you for that information, that's very important. Let me check our internal system logs for around January 11th... one moment please.
Okay, yes. I am seeing a record of a critical service outage on that date that specifically affected our returns portal. I am so sorry you were impacted by that. That is absolutely our fault.
So... you can see it happened?

I can. And since you made a documented attempt within the valid 10-day period and were blocked by our technical failure, I am more than happy to make an exception and approve this return for a full refund. This was a business fault, and you shouldn't be penalized for it.
Oh, thank you! Thank you so much, Charlie! That is such a relief. You have no idea how much I needed to hear that. I was so worried.

Of course, I'm glad I could get this sorted out for you. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email on file. Just package the item in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a wonderful help. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
